CXAS SCRAPI Command Line Interface — Full CI/CD Suite

The cxas CLI puts the full power of CX Agent Studio in your
terminal: pull/push apps, run evals, manage versions, analyze
conversation traces, and lint configurations or prompts.

--- Key Verification & Linting Tools — When to Run Which ---

• cxas lint     : Fast, deterministic structural linter.
                  Validates directory layout, YAML/JSON schemas,
                  app.yaml/app.json correctness, & basic structure.
                  When to run: Continuously during development,
                  in pre-commit hooks, and as a first CI gate.

• cxas llm-lint : AI semantic natural language prompt linter.
                  Analyzes instructions (instruction.txt,
                  global_instruction.txt, & dynamic callbacks)
                  for clarity, tone, persona, & contradictions.
                  When to run: When authoring prompt engineering,
                  before code reviews, or during qualitative QA.

options:

  --oauth-token OAUTH_TOKEN
                        Optional: OAuth token string for CES API authentication. Alternatively, set CXAS_OAUTH_TOKEN env var.
  --no-input            Disable all interactive prompts. Use this in CI/CD pipelines to prevent hanging on unexpected prompts.

lint.help:
usage: cxas lint [-h] [--app-dir APP_DIR] [--env-file ENV_FILE]
                 [--model MODEL] [--model-only] [--fix]
                 [--only {instructions,callbacks,tools,evals,config,structure,schema}]
                 [--rule RULE] [--json] [--list-rules] [--validate-only]
                 [--agents AGENTS] [--tools TOOLS] [--agent AGENT]
                 [--tool TOOL] [--toolset TOOLSET] [--guardrail GUARDRAIL]
                 [--evaluation EVALUATION]
                 [--evaluation-expectations EVALUATION_EXPECTATIONS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --app-dir APP_DIR     Path to the app directory to lint (default: current
                        directory).
  --env-file ENV_FILE   Optional: Path to an environment JSON file to validate
                        '$env_var' variableDeclarations against.
  --model MODEL         Target model (e.g., gemini-composite-v2,
                        gemini-3.1-flash-live, gemini-3-flash). If omitted,
                        inferred from app.json.
  --model-only          Run only model-specific rules for the target model
                        (exclude model-agnostic rules).
  --fix                 Show fix suggestions for each issue.
  --only {instructions,callbacks,tools,evals,config,structure,schema}
                        Only run a specific linter category.
  --rule RULE           Run specific rules only (comma-separated IDs, e.g.
                        I003,C005).
  --json                Output results as JSON.
  --list-rules          List all available lint rules.
  --validate-only       Run only structure and config rules.
  --agents AGENTS       Only discover/lint specific agents (comma-separated
                        list).
  --tools TOOLS         Only discover/lint specific tools (comma-separated
                        list).
  --agent AGENT         Validate a single agent directory against CES schema.
  --tool TOOL           Validate a single tool directory against CES schema.
  --toolset TOOLSET     Validate a single toolset directory against CES
                        schema.
  --guardrail GUARDRAIL
                        Validate a single guardrail directory against CES
                        schema.
  --evaluation EVALUATION
                        Validate a single evaluation directory against CES
                        schema.
  --evaluation-expectations EVALUATION_EXPECTATIONS
                        Validate a single evaluation expectations directory
                        against CES schema.

ci-test.help:
usage: cxas ci-test [-h] [--app-dir APP_DIR] [--display-name DISPLAY_NAME]
                    [--env-file ENV_FILE] --project-id PROJECT_ID --location
                    LOCATION

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --app-dir APP_DIR     Path to the app directory to test. Defaults to current
                        directory.
  --display-name DISPLAY_NAME
                        Optional: Deterministic display name for the temp
                        agent (e.g. [CI] PR-123). Overwrites existing.
  --env-file ENV_FILE   Path to a specific environment JSON file to include as
                        environment.json.
  --project-id PROJECT_ID
                        The GCP Project ID.
  --location LOCATION   The GCP Location (e.g., global, us-central1).

push.help:
usage: cxas push [-h] [--app-dir APP_DIR] [--to TO] [--env-file ENV_FILE]
                 [--app-name APP_NAME] [--display-name DISPLAY_NAME]
                 [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--location LOCATION]
                 [--create-version] [--version-name VERSION_NAME]
                 [--version-description VERSION_DESCRIPTION] [--overwrite]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --app-dir APP_DIR     Local app directory.
  --to TO               Target App Resource Name or Display Name.
  --env-file ENV_FILE   Path to a specific environment JSON file to include as
                        environment.json.
  --app-name APP_NAME   Target App ID to explicitly push to (v1beta API).
  --display-name DISPLAY_NAME
                        Display name for a new App if --to is not provided.
  --project-id PROJECT_ID
                        The GCP Project ID. (Optional if using Display Name)
  --location LOCATION   The GCP Location (e.g., global, us-central1).
                        (Optional if using Display Name)
  --create-version      Create a version after successful push.
  --version-name VERSION_NAME
                        Display name for the created version (used with
                        --create-version).
  --version-description VERSION_DESCRIPTION
                        Description for the created version.
  --overwrite           Overwrite existing data with imported data. Existing
                        resources that do not have a matching display name in
                        the imported app will be deleted

run.help:
usage: cxas run [-h] --app-name APP_NAME [--evaluation-id EVALUATION_ID]
                [--modality {text,audio}]
                [--display-name-prefix DISPLAY_NAME_PREFIX]
                [--tags TAGS [TAGS ...]] [--wait] [--filter-auto-metrics]
                [--golden-run-method {STABLE,NAIVE}]
                [--eval-type {goldens,scenarios,all}] [--runs RUNS]
                [--run-count RUN_COUNT] [--min-run-passes MIN_RUN_PASSES]
                [--min-pass-rate MIN_PASS_RATE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --app-name APP_NAME   The CXAS App ID (projects/.../locations/.../apps/...).
  --evaluation-id EVALUATION_ID
                        The evaluation resource name
                        (projects/.../locations/.../apps/.../evaluations/...).
  --modality {text,audio}
                        Evaluation execution modality (text or audio).
                        Defaults to text.
  --display-name-prefix DISPLAY_NAME_PREFIX
                        Run all tests whose display name starts with this
                        string.
  --tags TAGS [TAGS ...]
                        Space-separated list of tags. Runs tests containing
                        any of these tags.
  --wait                Wait for evaluation to complete and return exit code 0
                        on pass or 1 on fail.
  --filter-auto-metrics
                        Filter out automated metrics (semantic similarity,
                        hallucination) and only evaluate custom expectations.
  --golden-run-method {STABLE,NAIVE}
                        Method used to replay golden tests (STABLE or NAIVE).
                        Defaults to STABLE.
  --eval-type {goldens,scenarios,all}
                        Run a specific type of evaluation ('goldens',
                        'scenarios', 'all').
  --runs RUNS           Number of evaluation runs to execute for k-of-N
                        reconciliation.
  --run-count RUN_COUNT
                        Alias for --runs.
  --min-run-passes MIN_RUN_PASSES
                        Minimum passing runs per evaluation for k-of-N voting.
  --min-pass-rate MIN_PASS_RATE
                        Minimum fraction of evaluations (0.0-1.0) that must
                        pass; fails closed if 0 run.

delete.help:
usage: cxas delete [-h] [--app-name APP_NAME] [--display-name DISPLAY_NAME]
                   [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--location LOCATION] [--force]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --app-name APP_NAME   The CXAS App ID (projects/.../locations/.../apps/...).
                        Required if --display-name not provided.
  --display-name DISPLAY_NAME
                        The Display Name of the app to delete. Required if
                        --app-name not provided.
  --project-id PROJECT_ID
                        The GCP Project ID. (Optional if using Display Name)
  --location LOCATION   The GCP Location (e.g., global, us-central1).
                        (Optional if using Display Name)
  --force               Force delete even if there are child resources.

init.help:
usage: cxas init [-h] [--target-dir TARGET_DIR] [--force]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target-dir TARGET_DIR
                        Directory to install skills into (default: current
                        directory).
  --force               Overwrite existing files without prompting.

push-eval.help:
usage: cxas push-eval [-h] --app-name APP_NAME --file FILE [--prune]
                      [--prune-tag PRUNE_TAG] [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --app-name APP_NAME   The CXAS App ID (projects/.../locations/.../apps/...).
  --file FILE           Path to the YAML file or directory containing Golden
                        (conversations:) or Milestone/Simulation (evals:)
                        definitions.
  --prune               Delete server evaluations not present in the local
                        YAML definitions.
  --prune-tag PRUNE_TAG
                        Only prune server evaluations that carry this tag and
                        are absent from local YAML files.
  --dry-run             Preview evaluation upsert and prune actions without
                        mutating the server.
